parsed.rationale: For the reset-and-step environment and Harbor tasks the docs state isolation and name mechanisms (internal network the agent container cannot reach, per-episode token without scorer credential, labels never returned). The README 'Known issues' discloses that the eval/agents harness used for the paper's agentic runs leaves the problem list (which holds the labels) visible, inflating agentic patient-diagnosis scores.
